newInvite: Ask your contact for a new invite.

onDht.chosen: DHT only was chosen for this chat.
onDht.noCommonTransport: Your apps share no live transport. Short texts go through the DHT.
onDht.transport: No live link came up yet. It is retried in the background.
onDht.waiting: A live link is being tried in the background.

reason.keyMismatch: This contact's key does not match the saved one. Nothing was accepted.
reason.offline: You are offline. Pairing goes on once you are back online.
reason.publish: Could not put your invite on the network. Check your connection.
reason.rejected: Your contact's app refused the connection.
reason.resolve: Could not find the invite on the network. It may be old or mistyped.
reason.taken: Someone else joined with this invite first. Ask your contact for a new one.
reason.timeout: Your contact's app did not answer in time.
reason.transport: No direct link could be opened between your devices.

sayHello: You can chat now. Say hello!

slow.answering: Still exchanging keys with your contact…
slow.connecting: Still opening a direct link. Strict networks can take longer.
slow.knocking: Your contact's app has not answered yet. It may be closed or offline.
slow.publishing: Still publishing your invite. The network is slow to answer.
slow.resolving: Still looking for your contact on the network…
slow.waiting: Your contact has not opened the invite yet. It stays valid, so you can share it again.

stage.onDht: On the DHT. You can chat now; a live link is being tried
stage.publishing: Putting your invite on the network…
stage.resolving: Looking up the invite on the network…
stage.waiting: Waiting for your contact to open the invite
